QuestInfo.name: [Root Abyss Daily] Tribute for Vellum
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the #b#o7120111##k monsters in the North Garden on #r<Normal Mode>#k so that Laviola can escape.

0.0: W-who's there? Have you come to rescue me?
0.1: I am Laviola, daughter of the lizard tribe chief. I was chosen to be the sacrifice that kept our people safe from our god's wrath, but I didn't think it would be like this.
0.2: I just can't get out of here with all those #b#o7120111##k monsters prowling the North Garden. Please help me.

yes.1: It's not that I don't believe in you! I just need your conviction to get out of here. Please help.
yes.0: I should be able to escape if you take out 5 #b#o7120111##k and #b#o7120113##k monsters in the North Garden. Bring back #r20 of their Sharp Tails#k to make me feel safer.

no.0: Vellum will eat me alive if he finds me here!

yes.0: Thank you, you saved my life.
